# Prompt Vault

> Prompt Vault is a Japanese site for image-generation prompts.

Prompt Vault is a Japanese site for image generation prompts.

## What this site is for

- Search prompt blocks by title, purpose, or block ID
- Open templates
- Copy full prompts from the modal
- Reuse blocks for VTuber, social posts, reaction images, character sheets, banners, and comics

## Key pages

- [Home](https://prompt-vault-cg3.pages.dev/)
- [README](https://github.com/KAFKA2306/prompt-vault/blob/main/README.md)
- [Design notes](https://github.com/KAFKA2306/prompt-vault/blob/main/DESIGN.md)
- [Prompt database](https://github.com/KAFKA2306/prompt-vault/blob/main/db/prompts.json)
- [Pages verification](https://github.com/KAFKA2306/prompt-vault/blob/main/scripts/verify_pages.sh)

## Local use

- Run `python3 app.py` for local preview
- Run `python3 build.py` to regenerate `dist/`
